name: pcm-connect
description: PCM – Plateforme citoyenne de mobilisation (Hackathon Saint-Roch 2026, Ville de Québec)

scripts.install:all: npm install && (cd server && npm install) && (cd client && npm install)
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev:demo" "npm --prefix client run dev"
